value.rationale: Opinion-dynamics studies motivate the joint control of fragmentation probability and number of interactions before a precise opinion tolerance. On the smallest graph with two competing initial social edges, the complete exact probability-plus-conditional-latency law reveals a genuine reliability/speed tradeoff, including an optimal positive activity split and divergence of waiting time as reliability approaches certainty. A count or cosmetic substitution alone would not qualify; the characterized joint optimization objective provides the natural significance. It does not claim a general-network theorem.
